designer.mapEmpty: The application has no pages yet.
designer.start: Drag components from the palette onto the canvas, or press one to add it.
designer.nothing: Select an element on the canvas or in the structure to edit its props.
designer.expression: An expression: a list, an object or a value of JavaScript
designer.slotHint: Where it goes in its parent
designer.modifiersHint: The other classes its class takes
designer.list: Edit as a list of items

hints.screen: The screen of an Application: a column as high as its place (Sizing fill takes all of it).
hints.row: Elements side by side, wrapped to the next line when they do not fit.
hints.grid: Elements in a grid of columns as wide as the room allows.
hints.panel: A frame on the surface, with its padding.
hints.divider: A line between elements, across or upright.
hints.spacer: Takes the room left in a row: what follows goes to its end.
hints.heading: A heading of a level from 1 to 6.
hints.paragraph: A paragraph of text, of a size and a tone.
hints.textstyle: A text in a style of the Library: a title, an eyebrow, a caption...
hints.callout: A note set apart, of a tone.
hints.badge: A count or a mark beside a text.
hints.table: A table of columns and rows.
hints.document: Text as a document: headings, paragraphs and lists in their rhythm.
hints.slot: Where the component puts what it is given: the default slot, or the one of its name.
hints.outlet: Where the component of the Application puts the page of the route.

project.name: Name
project.title: Title
project.nameTaken: A component needs a name of its own, of letters and digits, from a capital letter.
project.noProps: No properties: add one for the inspector to show where the component is used.
project.propTaken: A property needs a name of its own, of letters, digits and _.
project.noSlots: No slots: put a Slot into the component to take content.
project.languageHint: The language of the page: en, ru...
project.routerHint: Where the route of a page is kept
project.noRoutes: The page has no route: no address opens it.
project.routesHint: The routes are set in the settings of the Application.
project.noGuards: No guards. A guard decides whether a route may open: it returns true, false, a path to go to instead, or this.$Fail(reason).
project.guardTaken: A guard needs a name of its own, of letters and digits, from a capital letter.
project.appComponentHint: The frame around the pages: a component of the project with a page place. Without it the pages take the whole window.
project.noOutlet: This component has no page place: add one from the palette, or the pages will not show.
project.notFound: Page of a path not found
project.notFoundHint: Shown for an address no route has; without it, the first page.
project.iconHint: The icon of the application: a square PNG of the project (1024 pixels), as /icon.png. elemenx build makes of it the icon of the tab, of the programs and of the phones.
project.splashHint: Shown from the first moment the page opens until the application is ready, in the browser and in the desktop and mobile programs.
project.splashImageHint: The address of a logo, as /logo.svg.
project.splashMinTimeHint: It stays at least so long, so it does not flicker.
project.splashColorsHint: Empty: the colors of the light or the dark theme of the system.
project.splashHTMLHint: Takes the place of the image, the text and the spinner (splash.html of the project).
project.pwaHint: elemenx build makes a manifest and a service worker; the browser offers to install it when the application asks (Elemenx.Install).
project.pwaShortNameHint: Under its icon; the title of the application without it.
project.pwaIconHint: A PNG of 512 pixels (or an SVG) of the project, as /icon.png.
project.pwaThemeHint: The bar of its window; empty: the background of the splash.
project.pwaOfflineHint: Its service worker keeps the files of the build.
project.pwaUpdateHint: How a new build takes the place of the one installed: Elemenx.Install.Update and Apply.

pwaUpdates.auto: At once, for the next start
pwaUpdates.prompt: When the application says, checked every hour
pwaUpdates.manual: When the application says, checked when it asks

pwaDisplays.minimal: Window with the buttons of the browser

designer.outlet: The page of the route goes here

window.keys: the arrows move the window, Shift with the arrows resizes it
